name: helm
description: One-click bridge from Claude Desktop / Cowork to a running helmd daemon: the host launches a pinned mcp-remote that talks to Helm's loopback-only MCP endpoint (http://127.0.0.1:4173/mcp) with your pairing token.

token.title: Pairing token
token.description: A Helm pairing token (helmd open prints a fresh one). The host masks this value and stores it securely; it is sent as the Authorization: Bearer header on every bridge request.

port.title: Daemon port
port.description: The TCP port your helmd daemon listens on (loopback only). Must match the daemon's configured port; the default is 4173.
